concept: IAM: restrict AssumeRole by aws:SourceIp in trust policy
tests: How to restrict cross-account AssumeRole to requests from the corporate IP range only.
expected: Condition with aws:SourceIp in the role's trust policy — the role can be assumed only from corporate IPs. Triggers: "assume a role", "only when requests originate from corporate IP range".
why_not: A permissions boundary caps maximum permissions but does not filter by IP on assume; an SCP restricts the whole account and is not the standard tool for this; a resource policy on CloudTrail is irrelevant.
